title: Exported helper exportReportCsv has no caller anywhere in the repo
description: exportReportCsv is added and exported but nothing imports or calls it; the only consumer of this module (summary.ts) uses buildReport alone. Dead weight the typechecker will not flag (unused exports are not errors).

title: Parameter includeTotals is accepted (and passed by the caller) but never read
description: buildReport(rows, includeTotals) never reads includeTotals — the body always computes the total. The caller passes true and gets no behavior for it.
